name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Bind federated playback paths, container, runtime, and audio tracks to the same reachable source. Exclude offline sources from legacy Auto selection and prevent exact-source streams from switching silently to incompatible files. Fetch posters from reachable Jellyfin or Plex sources so an offline catalog primary does not block artwork. Retain Jellyfin 12 media-source container metadata during full catalog sync so compatible clients can direct-play.
